snippet.title: Windstorm: The Legend of Khiimori Gameplay Overview - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Windstorm: The Legend of Khiimori is a horseriding adventure where you play as a brave courier in 13th-century Mongolia, and the developers dropped an insightful gameplay overview during the Future Games Show at gamescom. It's launching into early access on Steam and the Epic Games Store this November 4.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescom #windstormthelegendofkhiimori
